name: What should I prepare before Frasheski Construction arrives to make hardware adjustments?
description: Before we arrive, identify and mark specific items needing adjustment, and ensure the areas around these components are clear and accessible.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before Frasheski Construction arrives to make hardware adjustments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before Frasheski Construction arrives for hardware adjustments, it's helpful if you can clearly identify and mark the specific items that require attention. Consider making a list of all issues with doors, windows, cabinets, or other fixtures. Also, ensure the areas around these components are clear and accessible, allowing our team unobstructed access to perform the work efficiently. This preparation helps streamline our service and ensures all your concerns are addressed effectively during the visit. This offers clear preparation advice.
